authorization.text: On 2026-10-10 the owner directed: 'resume work. The agents should never stop working. You know the goal. No my review is needed.' This campaign takes netbka/engineering-platform#13 only: the owner-intervention core (blocker fingerprint, dedup, bounded recheck, resume of dependent tasks) on the existing supervisor store, with a fake transport only. tasks.title: Owner-intervention core: blocker fingerprint, dedup, recheck and resume
tasks.outcome: Each owner blocker is recorded once and rechecked; work resumes after the fix. Notices are drafted, not sent.
tasks.goal: Read #13 with all comments and docs/OWNER_INTERVENTION.md. Step 0: check on current main that the prerequisites #13 names exist (GOV-04/05 policy IDs, the #52 supervisor store, B0-B5 blocker handling in src/supervisor/controller.mjs). If a real prerequisite is missing, stop with blocked-owner-reserved and evidence; build no parallel state model. Otherwise extend the existing store and controller with a stable blocker fingerprint that holds no secret values, dedup, a category-bounded recheck schedule, and resume of dependent tasks only after recheck evidence passes (owner acknowledgement alone never resumes). Add a notification outbox recording what would be sent for B2-B5 per OWNER_INTERVENTION, with a transport interface and only a fake/no-op implementation, disabled by default.
constraints: Change only src/supervisor/**, tests/** and docs/SUPERVISOR.md (plus docs/OWNER_INTERVENTION.md if it needs an implementation-status note). Existing B3/B4 behaviour stays the same with the outbox disabled.
Store changes must be additive and migrate older stores idempotently; state recheck and resume semantics against crash or restart.
acceptance: The step-0 prerequisite check is reported with file and line evidence.
The same blocker raised repeatedly produces one fingerprint and one outbox entry; a changed cause produces a new one; no fingerprint or outbox field holds a secret value (tested).
Dependent tasks resume only after recheck evidence passes, survive a process restart without a duplicate dispatch, and B0/B1 never create an owner notification (tested).
With the feature disabled, existing supervisor tests pass unchanged; npm run check passes twice in a row with tallies in the report.
No network transport, Telegram code path or credential read exists; the report lists what owner-gated enablement still needs.
